3.text: To show her skill in this respect, Uˊpuñe told her son, a boy of fourteen,

4.text: to strip completely and lie down on the ground with his abdomen upward.

5.text: Then, after some performance with the drum, she took a knife, and, placing

6.text: the point between the first two fingers of her left hand, she put it on the

7.text: top of the boy’s stomach, and pretended to rip up the abdomen, holding the

8.text: knife by the handle with her right hand, and guiding the point all the time

9.text: with the fingers of her left. It certainly looked as if the flesh was really

10.text: cut open. On both sides, from under the fingers of Uˊpuñe, flowed little streams

11.text: of red blood, quickly increasing, and trickling down to the ground. The boy

25.text: During the operation, Uˊpuñe several times gave us to understand that

26.text: she felt hot, and then her daughter would bring her a lump of snow from

27.text: the big kettle, where quantities of snow and ice were melting for the daily

28.text: supply of water. It is quite usual for all the inhabitants of those countries

29.text: to swallow snow and ice when feeling hot. Some of the lumps, however,

30.text: must have contained fresh-frozen seal-blood coated with snow. A supply of

31.text: seal-blood was at that time in every native house, because the seal-catch

32.text: was going on. Of course, the snow and the blood melted in the mouth of

33.text: the performer, who could have let out the latter on the abdomen of the

34.text: patient, quite unperceived by the lookers-on. The boy was emaciated, and

35.text: I noticed that his skin lay in folds over all the joints of his body. He had

36.text: probably been trained, by the proper exercise of his muscles, to form the

37.text: skin of his abdomen into a vertical fold, which, when filled with the seal-

38.text: blood from Uˊpuñe’s mouth, looked exactly like a fresh wound. The children

39.text: of Uˊpuñe acted as her assistants, and must have had special training for

40.text: helping her in the performance of these tricks.
